summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASSED — multi-language code runner (python/js/cpp/java), password forgot+reset dev flow, single-use reset token, email verification, and hand-tuned company metadata (Accenture cognitive_game+15s, Zoho pen_paper, Tech Mahindra automata_fix). Frontend: new pages /forgot-password, /reset-password, /verify-email all render with expected data-testids; login has forgot-password-link; verify-email-banner correctly appears on /dashboard for freshly-signed-up password users and hides for already-verified users. Test user password restored to testpass123 at end of run.
critical_code_review_comments: aarav.test@placemint.dev was found with email_verified=True at start of testing — likely set by a previous run of the verify flow or a data migration. Not a bug (banner logic correctly hides for verified users), but flag: if the shared test user's email_verified state needs to be reset for future banner testing, do it directly via DB. My test uses a fresh signup to validate the banner path.
server.py continues to grow (~1170 lines with new auth endpoints); still recommend splitting into routers (auth/oa/payments/interview).

code_runner.py has NO sandbox/seccomp/memory limits (documented at top of file). Fine for MVP; must not go to prod without isolation — arbitrary user code executes with the FastAPI process's own privileges.

Password reset invalidates all other unused reset tokens for the user on success — good. Consider doing the same for verify_email tokens on successful verification (currently _consume_token marks only the used one; other outstanding verify tokens for the same user remain valid until expiry). Low priority.

/api/auth/password/forgot leaks whether the account is Google-only vs. password-based only via response shape (no dev_link for Google users). In dev mode that's fine, but for prod the branch `auth_provider != 'password'` should still take the same 'silent success' path — which it does. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 new UI touchpoints + banner flow verified)

test_credentials: aarav.test@placemint.dev / testpass123 (restored at end of test run). Fresh users generated per test.
seed_data_creation: Created two fresh users (test_it2_*@placemint.dev for verify-email API test; banner_*@placemint.dev via UI signup for banner test). Not cleaned up. aarav.test password was rotated to 'freshpass99' and then restored to 'testpass123'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 features working end-to-end. Multi-language runner uses real g++/node/javac on the container. Reset & verify tokens live in db.auth_tokens with kind field and single-use semantics. Frontend new routes are wired in App.js. Dashboard banner only appears when user.email_verified=false AND user.auth_provider=='password' — aarav.test currently has email_verified=true, so use a fresh signup account to see the banner path.
